newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major leaves Downing Street to meet Queen.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major leaves Downing Street to meet Queen.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major left his Downing Street residence at around 1125 GMT after a cabinet meeting for an audience with head of state Queen Elizabeth.
The Conservative prime minister was expected to ask the Queen to dissolve parliament, clearing the way for an election on May 1. Major's office said earlier he would meet the Queen at 1130 GMT.
Opinion polls put the opposition Labour party more than 20 points ahead of the Conservatives, who have been in power since 1979.
